description: ETF RFQ dataset: clients ask the bank to buy/sell an ETF, the bank quotes, and wins the trade if its price is best. Everything is documented in the dataset directory (files, readme, sample notebook).
target: Predict incoming netted, signed ETF flows over the next period (1 min to <=2 hours), at multiple aggregations (single ETF, broad/focused sectors, total). Can be cast as classification (buy/sell/none, or graded) or regression (signed flow). Downstream is a balanced long-short strategy exploiting the regularity; ignore transaction costs. The data is noisy: think hard about STRONG benchmarks and beat them. Only out-of-sample results matter -- work extra hard to verify NO information leaks from the future. Use cross-client information; client identity matters (who is price-sensitive, who reacts to which conditions, who trades together / influences whom). Condition on market conditions (returns, volume, volatility, liquidity; by-security and cross-sectional). ALL train/validation/test splits and moving windows MUST be split BY DATE.
